CustomObject.description: FIX-20178: exceptions to a PMT team's default owner, based on a ProjectProduct__c field value (e.g. Legal owner by LegalForm__c). For a team, the rule whose Values contains the project's value wins; otherwise the rule with empty Values; if the field is empty, the team's default owner (PMTTeam__mdt) stays. Read through the PMTMatrix Apex class.
CustomObject.label: PMT - Owner Rule
